prompt: My kei-proxy logs say 'policy bundle candidate rejected: invalid policy bundle schema ... dst_pattern web_search does not match' and all governed calls are being denied. What went wrong and how do I fix it?
assertions: The response identifies that the dst_pattern uses a bare name instead of the tool: prefix.
The response recommends updating the policy's dst_pattern to tool:<name> in the console.
The response mentions that kei-proxy fails closed (denies everything) when the schema is invalid.
The response references HAI-372 as the known bug.
The response suggests re-running kei runtime bootstrap or restarting kei-proxy serve after the fix.
